Stated Claim / Post Context:
Crazed University of Michigan student pushes conservative influencer to the ground in unhinged attack: ‘I should’ve f–king killed you’

A University of Michigan student was arrested after shoving conservative influencer Lizzy Benichou to the ground during a campus event.

Actual Article Body:
Switch between CA and NY editions here.

See more of our coverage in your search results.

A lunatic University of Michigan student went berserk and attacked a conservative influencer, shoving her to the ground before being arrested — then declared she should have “killed” her as police hauled her away.

The unidentified, irate student is seen in the viral video arguing with two men seated behind a table on the Ann Arbor campus Sunday, beneath a sign asking “Is Islam Compatible with the West?” — before clapping directly in one man’s face, causing him to flinch away.

“This is f–king stupid, bro,” the student shouted, then demanded to see their “f–king permit” as shocked onlookers recorded her meltdown.

Leftist Abdul supporter attacks @teameffujoe and @basedinmalibu then threatens to kill everyone after a table debate… pic.twitter.com/f17GdAmqhD

The man could be heard telling an off-camera campus officer that she had smacked him, which she vehemently denied, even as the crowd around her insisted they had it all on camera.

“I have several f–king eyewitnesses, I didn’t do f–king shit,” she yelled, then accused the man of “victimizing himself as a fully-grown man.”

“The f–king anti-Muslim people here who want to say I put a f–king hand on him,” she added.

As her expletive-filled outburst continued, the student turned her attention to a woman nearby — later identified as conservative influencer Lizzy Benichou — who asked whether the way she was dressed would be acceptable in Iran.

“Am I wrong? If you walked around like this in Iran, what would happen to her?” Benichou asked another person standing off to the side as the student got in her face.

The student then launched into a blindside attack against Benichou — shoving her to the ground before charging at her.

A nearby male onlooker then grabbed the enraged student before she could continue her attack.

“Don’t f–king talk to me like that!” she yelled as she was being pulled away from Benichou. “You wanna f–king get over here, bitch?!”

The student broke free from a bystander, shrugged off her backpack and lunged at Benichou again, but a nearby cop and another man ran over and stopped her.

The officer then forced her to the ground and tried to handcuff her as she struggled against him.

“Don’t resist,” the officer ordered.

“What the f–k are you going to do to me? Because I hit a dumb ass bitch in the face?” the unruly student said.

Once the student finally stopped fighting back, another officer arrived in a cop car, and the two were able to secure the handcuffs on her.

As the crazed student was being placed in the back of the car, she cried out that she had zero remorse for her actions.

“I’d do it again every f–king time, you stupid f–king c–t!” she shouted.

“I should’ve f–king killed you when I had the f–king chance,” she added, causing onlookers to audibly gasp.

“Are you kidding me?” someone off camera asked in shock.

“No, I’m not f–king kidding you,” she doubled down.

“You’re sick, you’re sick. Go to a mental hospital, bitch,” another onlooker yelled at the student, who was now in the backseat of the cop car.

“I’ve already been to a mental hospital,” the student shouted back. “And I’ll go again if it means killing you.”

Benichou later reassured her followers on X that she was “OK” after being “physically assaulted simply for showing up and exercising my First Amendment rights.”

“Political violence has NO place in the United States of America,” the influencer wrote. “I am incredibly grateful to the law enforcement officers who acted immediately to protect me. I am now in a safe location receiving care and I am going to be OK.”

Benichou added that the assault happened during a “Liberty Under Fire USA tour stop” and claimed her attacker had been “identified as a supporter of Abdul El-Sayed” — the Democratic candidate for US Senate in Michigan.

The attack came just days before Michigan voters head to the polls Tuesday to choose between El-Sayed and former Republican Rep. Mike Rogers in the US Senate race.

On Sunday, Rogers received the backing of Rep. Haley Stevens — the Democratic congresswoman who was narrowly defeated by El-Sayed in a hotly-contested primary.

University of Michigan police were responding to an unpermitted event on campus just before 5 p.m. when one of their officers witnessed the attack, the department told the Daily Mail.

“As the group was packing up to leave, officers witnessed a University of Michigan student assault a woman not affiliated with the university,” police said.

“The student was taken into custody, processed and released pending warrant authorization. No injuries were reported.”

The Post has reached out to campus police for further comment.
